purpose: Prospectively test whether a fixed geometry-only buoyant-gas sensor-ranking rule transfers to an independent full-scale indoor release dataset.

source.title: Dataset for H2SAFE - Controlled Gas Releases and Sensor-Response for Indoor Hydrogen Safety
source.license_obligation: Retain the NLR data notice and credit DOE/NLR/ALLIANCE in resulting publications.

known_before_freeze: five experiments across two full-scale indoor laboratories
helium is a nonflammable surrogate rather than hydrogen

exclusion_rules: exclude only a sensor channel explicitly marked missing, invalid or without coordinates
exclude an experiment only when a required source or time boundary is absent
do not exclude an experiment or sensor because the frozen predictor performs poorly

fixed_predictor.name: geometry_only_buoyant_rank_v1
fixed_predictor.interpretation: Higher score predicts earlier and stronger response for a buoyant surrogate plume. HVAC direction and obstacles are intentionally omitted and remain expected error sources.

measured_response_definition.baseline: median concentration before declared release start; if unavailable, median of the first 10 percent of samples
measured_response_definition.persistence: at least two consecutive finite samples above threshold
measured_response_definition.maximum_response: maximum baseline-corrected concentration during the declared release and 60 seconds after release end

secondary_outputs: results stratified by laboratory and HVAC state when metadata permit
prohibited_after_outcome_access: dropping failed experiments or sensors outside declared eligibility rules
using helium concentration as hydrogen vol-percent without a separately justified conversion
claim_boundary: A pass would support only a bounded, geometry-only sensor-ranking check for full-scale indoor helium surrogate releases. It would not validate hydrogen concentration magnitude, outdoor station dispersion, detector hardware dynamics, ignition, ESD effectiveness, safety distance, CFD accuracy or the full HRS digital twin.
